read_only_review_findings.finding: Removes external-image placeholder text without updating selection or search; a prior selectAll can leave selection.end beyond the new decodedText length, so selectedText can throw. Existing replaceResult/setPreferHtml reset selection and rerun search.

http.get buffers the complete response before the4MiB check. The new host/controller path also admits remote raster images without existing MailReadBudget.maxImagePixels or cumulative decoded-byte accounting.

Both async credential loaders schedule even when stale settings or failed catalog load prevent applying saved credentials. The callback captures no settings/account/session revision and can connect edited form contents.
Whitespace-only source nodes are dropped, removing meaningful separation in inline HTML such as A B.
Regex accepts any src attribute, including script/iframe nodes, although the UI action promises remote images.
Rebuilding the presentation drops previously added remote images on subsequent addImages calls despite the append contract.

validation: Read-only Git diff/ancestry and git merge-file -p against temporary files. No product tests, source edits, or remote refresh.
